allow: PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/players" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 8 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty players | Select-Object id, name, totalWins | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/players" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 12; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $data.players | Select-Object id, name, era, totalWins | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/players" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; \($r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json\).players | Where-Object { $_.id -eq "messi" -or $_.id -eq "ronaldo" } | Select-Object id, totalWins, totalAppearances | Format-Table -AutoSize)
